title: review follow-ups of PR #34568
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate: L1/L2 follow-ups, one card per PR. The source is PR #34568 (card #34527, which aligned the pm-dispatch text to #33941's merge-tree rule), passed on by area `o2-S`. It follows up work that has already landed, so it is not a new pm rule. Dedupe: `notify:serial when`, `review follow-ups of PR #34568`.

Suggested-grade: p3 · `domain:skills` · `pm:queue`

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34527 已把 pm-dispatch 文本对齐到「认领时和推送前各做一次 merge-tree」。但 `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` 里 `notify:serial` 的英文触发说明还写着旧说法「claimed file surfaces overlap」。另外，生成物接力的规则写在 landing-operations 的 D 节，不在车道章程里，按严格读法进不了串行队(L2 N4)。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Items

- [ ] `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`: the `notify:serial` `when` text names the merge-tree trigger and drops "claimed file surfaces overlap".
- [ ] L2 N4 on PR #34568: the generated-file relay reaches the serial queue by a pointer from the lane charter to `landing-operations.md` §D. Add the pointer only; do not restate the rule.

## Done when

`git grep -n "claimed file surfaces overlap" scripts/pm/ .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` is empty, and the charter's serial-queue line points to §D.
